title: Even a straw recovered is something
literal_meaning: Even a piece of straw obtained from a house fire is worth accepting.
meaning_odia: ସବୁକିଛି ନଷ୍ଟ ହେବା ବେଳେ କୁଟାଖିଏ ପରି ଅତି ସାମାନ୍ୟ ଜିନିଷ ମିଳିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ତାହା ଗ୍ରହଣଯୋଗ୍ୟ। ଉତ୍ସର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଅନୁସାରେ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ହାନି ଅପେକ୍ଷା ଅଳ୍ପ କିଛି ଫେରିପାଇବା ଶ୍ରେୟସ୍କର।
explanation: A straw is small beside the loss of a house, yet it is still something recovered. The inspected gloss makes the comparison explicit: when everything is being lost, even a small recovery is preferable. The saying gives a modest remnant value without pretending it replaces what has gone.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Most of a damaged collection cannot be restored, but a few readable pages survive. Someone quotes the saying to express why preserving those remnants still matters.
cultural_context: The verse contrasts the scale of a whole house with କୁଟାଖିଏ, a single small piece of straw. ସହି accepts that tiny remainder. The image shifts attention from the inadequacy of what survives to the difference between a little and nothing.

witnesses.locator: Page15, ninth item beginning ଘର ପୋଡିରୁ କୁଟାଖିଏ.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026; uploaded ପୋଡିରୁ and ପାଇଲେ retained unchanged.
Public counterpart uses ପୋଡ଼ିରୁ and ମିଳିଲେ. Explicit gloss prefers a small recovery when all is being destroyed.
